title: Kinsa Smart Thermometer Temperature Leaderboard
dataSources: Apple Health metrics (`apple:health`), Oura Ring daily readiness/sleep (`oura:daily`), Whoop recovery/strain (`whoop:cycle`), Withings body/blood-pressure (`withings:measure`), Dexcom CGM glucose (`dexcom:egv`).
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports (Health Auto Export, Shortcuts) via HEC; Oura, Whoop, Withings, Dexcom APIs via scripted REST inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=kinsa:reading temperature_f=*
| stats sum(temperature_f) as total_value, avg(temperature_f) as avg_value by member_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks household member values by total and average temperature across Kinsa reading events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `temperature_f` values for each Kinsa reading event and review total and average temperature by household member.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total temperature.
grandmaExplanation: It usefully which household member shows the biggest temperature numbers in your Kinsa reading data.
